displayIdentity.body: Liberty encounters a wounded conscience. However, that knowledge isn’t in all men. But some, with consciousness of an idol until now, eat as of a thing sacrificed to an idol, and their conscience, being weak, is defiled. Therefore, if food causes my brother to stumble, I will eat no meat forever more, that I don’t cause my brother to stumble.
displayIdentity.title: Liberty encounters a wounded conscience
